messages:
Ethan Hall: Hi folks 1000000
Ethan Hall: Hey team, Ethan here  excited to join infra. Quick intros: previously at a payments startup, mostly SRE work. First-day checklist Qs: 1) SSH access to git? I added my public key to the form but cloning private repos errors with 'Permission denied (publickey)'. 2) VPN: do I need it for initial MDM + docker images? 3) Who should I ping for onboarding cred access? Fun fact: built a tiny synth and play it terribly.

Samira Li: Welcome Ethan! :tada: Im your manager. For SSH - People Ops should have forwarded keys to the infra group; give it ~15 mins. For VPN yes, connect to Redwood-Office for provisioning. Buddy this week is Maya.

Maya (IT): Hey Ethan 1000000
Maya (IT): Ill check key provisioning. Meanwhile run `ssh -v git@github.com` and paste output if it still fails. VPN instructions here: https://setup.redwood.com/vpn (use wireguard profile). For MDM we recommend enrolling while on VPN or on office network. If image pulls fail, try `docker login registry.redwood.com` then `docker pull`.

Travis (People Ops): Hi Ethan! Badge ready at Reception after 1pm. We sent a payroll form and emergency contact form  please complete those. I confirmed we received your SSH public key but Ill re-run the sync with infra group now.

DevOps-Bot: Automated note: repo-access job started for user ethan.hall. Task #4721 queued. Status: processing.

Ethan Hall: Thanks Samira/Maya/Travis. SSH verbose shows: "debug1: Offering public key: /Users/ethan/.ssh/id_ed25519 ED25519" then "Permission denied (publickey)." Will paste full output if it still fails after a retry. Also trying WireGuard now.

Maya (IT): If key appears offered but denied, check GitHub username match with SSH key mapping. Also ensure your git config user.email matches the email People Ops used. If still blocked, I'll trigger a manual add to the infra team.

Samira Li: Small logistics: standup is 9:30 PT, we do a 15-min buddy sync 11:00. No need to be online before 9:30. We'll do a quick 5-min intro for you at all-hands tomorrow.

Ethan Hall: Quick question  who manages the test cluster credentials? I saw a note about request forms.

Maya (IT): Test cluster requests go through infra-requests (https://infra.redwood.com/requests). I can pre-approve one request for you once SSH is sorted.

onboarding-bot: Reminder: New hire orientation 2026-03-25 09:00 PT 1000000

Travis (People Ops): Also FYI we assigned you a buddy lunch with the infra team on Friday  calendar invite sent.

Ethan Hall: Awesome, thanks everyone. Will paste SSH logs in a few minutes if still failing. Looking forward to the synth jam later. :)
